newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM to raise January rubber futures margin fees.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM to raise January rubber futures margin fees.

text.p: The Tokyo Commodity Exchange (TOCOM) said on Friday it would raise the margin requirement on its January rubber futures contract by 10,000 yen per trading lot, effective from Monday.
The rise will bring the total January requirement to 157,750 yen, TOCOM said in a statement.
The increases are intended to cool overheated trade.
The requirement on its February rubber futures contract will be unchanged at 62,500 yen while those on other rubber contracts will remain at 52,500 yen, TOCOM said.
